--clean.help: Clean runtime environment if test fail

--custom-config.help: [dev] run a specific subset of configs parser:file.yaml,scenarios:file.yaml

--daemon.help: Daemonize, go background, drop PID file, log to file

--dsn.help: Process a single data source in time-machine

--dump-state.help: [dev] Dump bucket state at the end of run.

--fast.help: Skip slow operations, like cpu profiling

--file.help: Process a single file in time-machine

--force.help: Force install : Overwrite tainted and outdated files

--host.help: Address to expose AppSec for hubtest

--max-items.help: Maximum number of alert items to keep in the database

--no-clean.help: Don't clean runtime environment if test succeed

--order-event.help: enforce event ordering with significant performance cost

--report-success.help: Report successful tests too (implied with json output)

--restore-state.help: [dev] restore buckets state from json file

--schmilblick.help: set a schmilblick (use in tests only)

--transform.help: expr to apply on the event after acquisition

--winsvc.help: Windows service Action: Install, Remove etc..

-dsn.help: Process a single data source in time-machine

-label.help: Additional Labels for file in time-machine

-order-event.help: enforce event ordering with significant performance cost

-transform.help: expr to apply on the event after acquisition

backup.help: This command has been removed. You can backup/restore the configuration by other means.

check.help: Check if a value is in an allowlist

context.help: Manage context to send with alerts

cscli.help: cscli allows you to manage crowdsec

dashboard.help: Manage your metabase dashboard container [requires local API]

datasources.help: generate datasource (acquisition) configuration from a setup file

detect.help: Detect available fields from the installed parsers

doc.help: Generate the documentation related to cscli commands. Target directory must exist.

dump.help: Dump all your configuration to a zip file for easier support

enroll.help: Enroll this instance to https://app.crowdsec.net [requires local API]

hubtest.help: Run functional tests on hub configurations

import.help: Import values to an allowlist from a CSV file

install-acquisition.help: Generate acquisition configuration from a setup file

install-hub.help: Install recommended hub items from a setup file

ip.help: Delete bans for given ip from db

machines.help: Manage local API machines [requires local API]

prompt.help: Prompt for configuration values in an interactive fashion

prune.help: prune multiple bouncers from the database

range.help: Delete bans for given ip from db

reinject.help: reinject an alert into profiles to trigger notifications

restore.help: This command has been removed. You can backup/restore the configuration by other means.

save.help: Backup configuration (api, parsers, scenarios etc.) to directory

status.help: Check status with the Central API (CAPI)

support.help: Provide commands to help during support

sync.help: Sync with the Polling API, pulling all non-expired orders for the instance

test.help: send a generic test alert to notification plugin

update.help: Download the latest index (catalog of available configurations)

upgrade.help: Upgrade all configurations to their latest version

validate.help: validate a machine to access the local API
